title: Release Manager Settings
description: Configure roles and enable optional features for the Release Manager app. Changes take effect immediately after saving.

releaseManagers.title: Release Managers
releaseManagers.description: User groups with full access: create, edit, and delete releases; freeze and unfreeze releases; access app settings; and view the audit trail. Assign at least one group to ensure someone can manage the app.

lightManagers.title: Light Release Managers
lightManagers.description: User groups that can edit existing release versions (change title, dates, description, and planned issues) but cannot create or delete releases, freeze or unfreeze releases, or access app settings.

manualIssueManagement.title: Feature: Manual Issue Management
manualIssueManagement.description: When enabled, release managers can manually override the progress status of individual planned issues — marking them as Fixed, Merged, or Descoped — independently of the issue's actual custom field value in YouTrack. Useful when an issue is closed via a non-standard workflow or needs to be excluded from progress tracking without being removed from the release.

metaIssuesEnabled.title: Feature: Meta Issues
metaIssuesEnabled.description: When enabled, release managers can create meta-issues inside a release — placeholder entries that group or represent a set of related work (e.g. an epic or a feature). Meta-issues appear in the release alongside regular planned issues and can carry their own progress state.

customFieldsMapping.title: Feature: Custom Field Sync
customFieldsMapping.description: When enabled, a 'Custom Field Mapping' section appears in the project's app settings. Configure a YouTrack enum or build-type custom field to act as the release assignment field: when a user changes that field on an issue, the workflow automatically adds or removes the issue from the corresponding release. Requires the 'Update Releases on Custom Field Change' workflow to be active in the project.
